patch_description: Implement the recommended "best-of-cycles" pool strategy: track the top-3 distinct configurations found across all seeds (diversity measured by mean pairwise point distance > 0.1), then run one short reheat from each pool member plus one from the global best, followed by greedy polish on each. This escapes the plateau at min_area_normalized ~0.02 by exploring multiple good basins instead of restarting only from single configs. Also add a few extra deterministic structured seeds (boundary-heavy and 13-gon) to broaden the initial basin search, and slightly increase anneal iterations within time budget.
